'''Olnom Grilnor''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast master]] who had fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
A Force-sensitive native to the town of [[Teron's Bluff]], Olnom Grilnor was seduced by the dark side and driven mad during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Driven from his home by the leaders of Teron's Bluff, Grilnor fled into the wilderness where for over a year he began to plot his revenge on the settlement and his former neighbors. Living in a tent in the forest, Grilnor had access to an ancient [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecording]] which detailed the powers of a [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast master]]. Bending the local [[Manka cat/Legends|manka]] cats to his will, Grilnor sent the savage felines against the town in hopes of driving the people out of their homes. During the attacks, his presence attracted local [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and others hired to eliminate the threat he posed.<ref name="SS" />
